outcome: Abundance of placental nutrient transporters (MCT10, FABP3, RBP1, SLC2A9, SLC38A2, SLC38A4, SLC27A6)
cohort: The study included placentas from women with gestational diabetes mellitus (GDM) and women with normal glucose tolerance, all of whom delivered normal birthweight infants (n=8 GDM, n=9 control).
finding: In placentas from GDM women delivering normal birthweight infants, the abundance of specific nutrient transporters (MCT10, FABP3, RBP1) was reduced, and gene expressions of others (SLC2A9, SLC38A2, SLC38A4, SLC27A6) were downregulated compared to normal glucose tolerance controls.
